articles.title: Spain joins growing list of countries shutting out Polymarket and Kalshi
articles.snippet: The platforms were blocked for operating without licenses required by Spanish gambling law, citing a lack of safeguards for minors and self-excluded gamblers.

articles.title: Bitcoin demand gauge sinks to worst level since December as spot buying weakens
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant’s 30-day apparent demand indicator is negative, signaling that buyers aren’t absorbing the available supply and leaving the market vulnerable.

articles.title: StablR freezes USDR and EURR after attacker mints $13.5 million in unbacked tokens
articles.snippet: The breach, linked to a 1-of-3 multisig wallet weakness, allowed attackers to compromise a key and mint $13.5 million in unbacked tokens, netting them $2.8 million.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks another lower high as stocks rally, AI tokens outperform
articles.snippet: The bitcoin price chart is forming a potential lower high while ether languishes in a months-old range even as S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 index futures push higher.

articles.title: HYPE briefly overtakes Dogecoin, privacy tokens slide as US strikes on Iran rattle markets
articles.snippet: ZEC and XMR dropped 5% in a session that saw most major tokens pull back after weeks of gains, with the move tracking renewed Middle East tension and a rebound in oil prices.
